items.title: Actual PBPS reflected resolvent: one solution before all cutoffs

source.anchor: PBPS2609.06905v1 Section2.2 equations2.6-2.14 and AppendixC.1 omitted same-solution compact localization analytic prerequisite; SPHMC2609.06906v1 Section4.1 actual BL dependency only. No numbered source localization theorem is claimed.
source.attribution: Samplinglib explicit same-solution compact localization prerequisite to Chen, Chewi, Lu and Zhang AppendixC.1; not a quoted numbered theorem or complete LemmaC.1/Poincare result.

items.statement: From actual source V/alpha/beta/eta construct true common augmentation R/S and reflected law, and for each y the original dense closable D_y before epsilon/forcing. Construct one actual u before all cutoffs in that same closure domain. Retain the actual all-domain variational equation, ordinary locally integrable u/G, all C1 compact directional weak-gradient tests, squared local integrability of r=epsilon*u+inner(grad W_y,G)-f, compact-volume L2 of u/G/r and every C2 original distribution test. For every C2 compact chi define v=chi*u, Gchi=chi*G+u*grad chi, Fchi=chi*r+2 inner(grad chi,G)+u Delta chi. Prove genuine global-volume L2 of v/Gchi/Fchi and each topological support contained in tsupport chi. For every C1 compact psi/direction a both weak-gradient products are L1 with integral psi inner(Gchi,a)=-integral v Dpsi[a]. For every C2 compact phi both PDE products are L1 with integral v Delta phi=integral Fchi phi. The same u is chosen before all cutoffs; only smooth test/cutoff functions have classical derivatives. Reflected and unreflected RGO laws/operators/scales remain distinct.
assumptions: E has the same finite real Hilbert/Borel/full-space structure including dimension zero. Source V is C2 with all-point/all-direction alpha I<=Hess V<=beta I, alpha,beta NNReal, 0<alpha<=beta, eta>0 and beta eta<=1.

Actual common Gibbs/Gaussian augmentation J and Markov disintegrating R/S are constructed. S_y=(2x-y)#R_y is precisely volume.tilted(-W_y), W_y(z)=V((y+z)/2)+norm(z-y)^2/(8eta), with true C2 regularity and positive integrable partition.

For every y one original dense closable compact-smooth gradient D_y with closed closure is fixed before epsilon/input. For each epsilon>0 and true f in L2(S_y), one u/G/r serves all compact sets, ordinary tests and all C2 compact cutoffs. Existence is fiberwise; no jointly measurable solution selector, RGO operator identity or localized weighted-domain membership is concluded.
